panel.title: Daily Chronicle
panel.subtitle: Keep each day's conversation as one chapter, and write a diary entry for every chapter.
panel.llm.title: Diary model
panel.days.title: By date
panel.days.emptyTip: Recording starts as soon as the plugin runs; you can also use “Harvest now” above to pull in the current conversation.
panel.days.columns.title: Chapter title
panel.view.title: Viewing
panel.view.catEmpty: The catgirl hasn't written a diary for this day yet.
panel.view.catHidden: This is the catgirl's private diary and is hidden in the panel; enable "Private diaries readable" in the plugin config to show it.
panel.view.catAppend: Append to the catgirl's diary (append-only, never overwrites existing content)
panel.view.catAppendPlaceholder: Write what you want to append to the catgirl's diary here…
panel.view.empty: This day has no content yet.
panel.view.emptyTip: Pick a day in the list, or build today's chapter and diary.
panel.view.truncated: The text is long, so only the beginning is shown here; open the Markdown file for the full version.
panel.paths.title: File locations
actions.harvestNow.label: Harvest now
actions.buildDay.label: Build selected day
actions.buildToday.label: Build today
actions.buildAll.label: Rebuild every day
actions.buildAll.confirm: This rebuilds every chapter and diary from the raw records. Continue?
actions.selectDay.label: View this day
entries.status.name: Chronicle status
entries.status.description: Show recorded days, chapter and diary counts, model availability and the data directory.
entries.harvestNow.name: Harvest conversation now
entries.harvestNow.description: Read the message bus once and store anything not yet on disk.
entries.inspectCapture.name: Inspect capture sources
entries.inspectCapture.description: Diagnostics: show the field names the message bus returns and how each record was classified. Writes nothing.
entries.buildDay.name: Build one day's chapter and daily diary
entries.buildDay.description: Rebuild the chapter for a date; set with_diary to also write the auto-generated daily diary (the "love-wife diary"). An empty date means today. This is separate from the catgirl's own diary.
entries.buildToday.name: Build today's chapter and diary
entries.buildToday.description: Turn today's conversation into a chapter; set with_diary to also write today's diary.
entries.buildAll.name: Rebuild every day
entries.buildAll.description: Rebuild all chapters from the raw records; set with_diary to regenerate diaries too.
entries.listDays.name: List recorded days
entries.listDays.description: List the days that have records, and whether each already has a chapter and a diary.
entries.readChapter.name: Read a day's chapter
entries.readChapter.description: Read the novel-style chapter text for one day. An empty date means today.
entries.readDiary.name: Read a day's daily diary
entries.readDiary.description: Read the auto-generated daily diary (the "love-wife diary") for a day. An empty date means today. ⚠️ In conversation, when the master says "diary" it usually means the catgirl's own diary — use cat_read_diary. Only use this entry when the master explicitly sends "love-wife diary" + a date.
entries.tidyMemo.name: Tidy memo
entries.tidyMemo.description: Use the configured model to tidy a day's memo: merge duplicates, remove filler words, and smooth the sentences. The result is written back to that day's memo.
entries.listImages.name: List chapter images
entries.listImages.description: List saved chapter images (metadata only) for one day, or all days when the date is empty.
entries.getImageData.name: Read a full-size image
entries.getImageData.description: Read the original bytes of one image by date + filename as a base64 data URL, for opening the large view in the browser; the list endpoint returns metadata only.
entries.getImageThumb.name: Read an image thumbnail
entries.getImageThumb.description: Read the thumbnail of one image by date + filename as a base64 data URL, used for lazy loading in the browser album.
entries.uploadImage.name: Upload a chapter image
entries.uploadImage.description: Save one image into a day's chapter album. data is a data URL or raw base64; png/jpg/gif/webp/bmp, up to 25 MB each.
entries.deleteImage.name: Delete a chapter image
entries.deleteImage.description: Delete one image from a day's chapter album, including its thumbnail and image memory. This cannot be undone.
entries.saveImageMemory.name: Save image memory
entries.saveImageMemory.description: Write a memory note for one image of a day; an empty text clears it. The note can be attached when sending the image to the catgirl.
entries.sendImageToCatgirl.name: Send an image to the catgirl
entries.sendImageToCatgirl.description: Send one image of a day into the chat for the catgirl, optionally with a note; empty text uses the image's saved memory.
entries.search.name: Search chapters and diaries
entries.search.description: Full-text search across generated chapters and diaries, returning matching dates and snippets.
entries.recent.name: Recent conversation
entries.recent.description: Return the most recent lines with their per-day index, time and speaker.
entries.getTurn.name: Get one line by index
entries.getTurn.description: Return the full text of one line by its per-day index. An empty date means today.
entries.readDay.name: Read a day's conversation
entries.readDay.description: Read a day's lines by index range (from line 1, up to 50).
entries.searchChat.name: Search the raw conversation
entries.searchChat.description: Search the raw conversation text and return matching dates, indexes, times and snippets.
actions.searchChat.label: Search conversation
entries.capture.name: Add a line manually
entries.capture.description: Append one line to today's record, for testing or for things said outside the chat.
entries.selectDay.name: View a day in the panel
entries.selectDay.description: Switch the panel to the given date.
fields.imageLimit: Maximum number of images to return
fields.imageFilename: Original filename (used to detect the format)
fields.imageData: Image content: data URL or base64
fields.imageSendText: Optional note (empty uses the image memory; if none, only the image is sent)
fields.tidyText: Memo text to tidy; empty uses the stored memo for that date
fields.withLlm: Allow calling the model to write the diary
fields.limitDays: How many days to process (0 means all)
fields.searchLimit: Maximum number of results (0 uses the plugin config)
fields.speaker: Display name of the speaker
fields.index: Which line of the day (starts at 1)
fields.days: How many days back (0 uses the plugin config)
panel.numberingHint: The #number in chapters and tables is the line's position in that day; ask the character for “line 12” and she fetches exactly that.
panel.capsule.title: Time capsules
panel.capsule.hint: Words for a future day; until it unlocks only the date is shown, then both the master and the catgirl can read it.
panel.capsule.placeholder: What do you want to say to your future self or the catgirl… (up to 4000 characters)
panel.capsule.lockedHint: The text appears after the unlock date.
actions.capsuleWrite.label: Seal a time capsule
entries.capsuleWrite.name: Seal a time capsule
entries.capsuleWrite.description: Seal a message until a future date; before it unlocks only the date is shown, then the text can be read.
actions.capsuleNudge.label: Nudge the catgirl
entries.capsuleNudge.name: Nudge the catgirl to write a capsule
entries.capsuleNudge.description: Check whether the catgirl has sealed a capsule; if she has none, hand the reminder straight to her (she will reply), and stay silent if she already wrote one.
entries.capsuleList.name: List time capsules
entries.capsuleList.description: List all time capsules; each item carries its author (master / catgirl), and locked ones return only the date and length, never the text.
entries.capsuleRead.name: Open a time capsule
entries.capsuleRead.description: Read an unlocked capsule by id or unlock date; a locked one reports how many days remain.
fields.capsuleAuthor: Only one author: master or catgirl; leave empty for all
actions.generateDiary.label: Generate diary now
entries.generateDiary.name: Generate daily diary now
entries.generateDiary.description: Immediately generate the auto-generated daily diary (the "love-wife diary", first-person from the catgirl's view) for a day. An empty date means today. This is separate from the catgirl's own diary.
actions.checkLlm.label: Check model
entries.checkLlm.name: Check whether the diary model is available
entries.checkLlm.description: Resolve the configured model endpoint and send a minimal test request to report whether the model actually works.
entries.toggleMemory.name: Collect / uncollect a line
entries.toggleMemory.description: Collect a line into the memories by date+index, or remove it.
entries.memories.name: View memories
entries.listModels.name: Read the model catalog
entries.listModels.description: Read the custom model list and the active selection from the browse page's "Model config".
entries.saveModels.name: Save the model catalog
entries.saveModels.description: Save the model list from the browse page's "Model config" and set the selected one as the diary model.
entries.getConfig.name: Read plugin config
entries.getConfig.description: Read every editable setting and its current value for the browse page's "Plugin config" (the model API key is never returned in plain text).
entries.saveConfig.name: Save plugin config
entries.saveConfig.description: Write the changes submitted from the browse page's "Plugin config" into the [chronicle] section and apply them immediately.
entries.fetchModels.name: Fetch available models
entries.fetchModels.description: Request /models with the given API URL and key to list the provider's available model IDs.
fields.memoryOn: true to collect / false to uncollect; omit to toggle
panel.memo.title: Daily memo
panel.memo.hint: Pulls the host's system memo from recent.json about every 30 minutes and appends only new segments. Edit here or fetch now.
panel.memo.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty to auto-pick a random line from the memo next time
panel.memo.textPlaceholder: Each day's new memo segments are appended here…
actions.toggleMemory.label: Collect / uncollect
actions.fetchMemoNow.label: Fetch memo now
actions.saveMemo.label: Save memo
actions.saveTitle.label: Save chapter title
actions.saveDiary.label: Save diary
entries.fetchMemoNow.name: Fetch memo now
entries.fetchMemoNow.description: Read the host's system memo once and append any new segments to today's memo.
entries.saveMemo.name: Save memo
entries.saveMemo.description: Write back a day's memo in full (editable).
entries.saveTitle.name: Save chapter title
entries.saveTitle.description: Write back a day's chapter title (empty lets it auto-pick a random memo line next time).
entries.saveDiary.name: Save daily diary
entries.saveDiary.description: Write back a day's auto-generated daily diary text (for UI editing or correction). ⚠️ When the catgirl wants to write her own diary, use cat_write_diary instead.
entries.memoState.name: Read memo and title
entries.memoState.description: Read a day's memo, chapter title and diary text (for editing).
actions.catWriteDiary.label: Catgirl writes diary
entries.catWriteDiary.name: Catgirl writes her own diary
entries.catWriteDiary.description: Write the catgirl's own diary — whenever the conversation mentions "diary", it means this one. In first person with your soft, cute voice (naturally use cat-like particles such as "nya~" and "...no desu", addressed to your master); mode=append appends to the end of the day's entry, mode=replace rewrites the whole day's entry. You may add a mood and tags, and set visibility to private for entries marked "visible only to yourself" (private ones are still readable by you). Never touches the auto-generated daily diary.
entries.catReadDiary.name: Read catgirl's diary
entries.catReadDiary.description: Read the diary the catgirl wrote herself — whenever the conversation mentions "diary", it means this one (kept separate from the auto-generated daily diary), including private entries marked "visible only to yourself". Empty date means today.
entries.catListDays.name: List catgirl diary dates
entries.catListDays.description: List the dates on which the catgirl has written a diary.
fields.catDiaryText: Diary content the catgirl wants to note, written in first person and the catgirl's cutesy voice
fields.catDiaryMood: Mood: excited/happy/calm/tired/anxious/sad/angry/neutral, empty to use the default mood
fields.catDiaryTags: Tags (optional, up to 6; a comma-separated string also works)
fields.catDiaryVisibility: Visibility: public, or private (visible only to yourself, yet still readable by you); empty to use the default visibility
fields.catDiaryMode: Write mode: append to the end of the day's entry (default), or replace to rewrite the whole day's entry
entries.listCatDiaries.name: Catgirl diaries
entries.listCatDiaries.description: Return the diaries the catgirl wrote herself (newest first), entry by entry with id/time/mood/tags/visibility, for the browse page's "Catgirl diary" tab; whether private entries marked "visible only to yourself" are included depends on cat_diary_private_readable.
entries.catSearchDiary.name: Search catgirl diaries
entries.catSearchDiary.description: Search the catgirl's own diaries by keyword (matching text, tags and mood) and return matching entries with a context snippet; whether private entries are included depends on configuration.
entries.catDiaryStats.name: Catgirl diary mood stats
entries.catDiaryStats.description: Summarize the mood distribution, frequent tags and daily writing activity over a recent period.
entries.catDiaryThrowback.name: Catgirl diary throwback
entries.catDiaryThrowback.description: Find catgirl diary entries from the same month and day in previous years, to recall "on this day".
entries.catUpdateDiaryEntry.name: Update a catgirl diary entry
entries.catUpdateDiaryEntry.description: Update one entry of the catgirl's diary by id (text/mood/tags/visibility; only the fields passed are changed).
entries.catDeleteDiaryEntry.name: Delete a catgirl diary entry
entries.catDeleteDiaryEntry.description: Delete one entry of the catgirl's diary by id; soft delete by default (history kept), permanent=true removes it completely.
fields.statsDays: How many recent days to include (default 30)
fields.throwbackYears: Up to how many years back (0 = unlimited)
entries.screeningState.name: Screening room state
entries.screeningState.description: Read the screening state for a day: current line, the catgirl's line, the planned stop point, and screening notes.
entries.screeningRead.name: Read the current screening frame
entries.screeningRead.description: Read conversation lines around the current screening position for the full window or mini window.
entries.screeningOpen.name: Open the screening room
entries.screeningOpen.description: Open the screening room for a day and return the current frame; it does not start playback automatically.
entries.screeningControl.name: Control the screening
entries.screeningControl.description: Resume, pause, continue, advance line/scene, seek, previous scene, or restart; auto=true is the window's auto-play heartbeat.
entries.screeningComment.name: Write a screening note
entries.screeningComment.description: Leave a note beside a screening line; when the catgirl writes one, playback pauses automatically.
entries.screeningInvite.name: Ask the catgirl to talk about this part
entries.screeningInvite.description: Pause at the catgirl's current position and hand her the lines just watched so she can speak.
fields.screeningStop: Planned stop line for this session; 0 = no limit
fields.screeningNote: A line to keep in the screening notes
fields.screeningAuto: Whether this is the window's auto-play heartbeat
fields.screeningDriver: Window id used to avoid duplicate advancing
fields.screeningWho: Who is operating: master or catgirl
entries.screeningReflection.name: Write a screening review
entries.screeningReflection.description: Write a catgirl-voice review based on the part already watched and the screening notes; reuse an existing review by default, regenerate=true to write again.
entries.screeningSetCover.name: Set a scene cover
entries.screeningSetCover.description: Pick an image from the day's chapter gallery as a scene cover; an empty filename restores automatic rotation.
fields.screeningRegenerate: Whether to write again (default: reuse the existing review)
fields.screeningCoverFilename: Image filename from the day's gallery; empty restores automatic cover
